notes.title: How to: Setup "promote to live" in github
notes.body:
WORKSPACE APP - ONE-TIME PROMOTE-TO-LIVE SETUP

GOAL
=====
workspace-test  = Development / Testing
workspace       = Production / Live

Workflow:

workspace-test
      ↓
Test & Validate
      ↓
GitHub Action
      ↓
Promote to Live
      ↓
workspace
      ↓
GitHub Pages publishes production


STEP 1 - CREATE TEST REPOSITORY
===============================

Create repository:

workspace-test

Keep existing repository:

workspace

as Production.


STEP 2 - ENABLE GITHUB PAGES
============================

For BOTH repositories:

Settings
→ Pages
→ Deploy from Branch
→ main
→ /root
→ Save

URLs:

Test:
https://<username>.github.io/workspace-test/

Production:
https://<username>.github.io/workspace/


STEP 3 - CREATE SHARED PROMOTION TOKEN
======================================

GitHub
→ Settings
→ Developer Settings
→ Personal Access Tokens
→ Fine-Grained Tokens
→ Generate New Token

Token Name:

PROMOTE_TO_LIVE_TOKEN

Repository Access:

All repositories

Repository Permissions:

Contents = Read and Write

Everything else:

No Access

Generate token.

Copy token immediately.


STEP 4 - STORE TOKEN IN TEST REPOSITORY
=======================================

Open repository:

workspace-test

Settings
→ Secrets and Variables
→ Actions
→ New Repository Secret

Name:

LIVE_REPO_TOKEN

Value:

<paste token>

Save.


STEP 5 - CREATE PROMOTE TO LIVE WORKFLOW
========================================

File:

.github/workflows/promote-to-live.yml

Contents:

--------------------------------------------------
name: Promote to Live

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  promote:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Test Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout Live Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: YOUR_USERNAME/workspace
          token: ${{ secrets.LIVE_REPO_TOKEN }}
          path: live

      - name: Promote Approved Version
        run: |
          cp index.html live/index.html

      - name: Commit and Push
        working-directory: live
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add index.html

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Nothing to promote"
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "Promote tested version to live"
          git push
--------------------------------------------------

Replace:

YOUR_USERNAME

with your GitHub username.


STEP 6 - INITIAL TEST
=====================

Upload current Workspace stable file as:

index.html

to:

workspace-test

Verify test site works.


STEP 7 - FUTURE DEVELOPMENT PROCESS
===================================

NEVER update production directly.

Always:

1. Modify workspace-test
2. Test
3. Run validation checklist
4. Lock SHA-256
5. Promote to Live


STEP 8 - PROMOTE TO LIVE
========================

workspace-test

→ Actions
→ Promote to Live
→ Run Workflow

GitHub automatically:

✓ Copies index.html
✓ Updates workspace repo
✓ Commits changes
✓ Pushes changes
✓ Publishes production site


STEP 9 - ROLLBACK
=================

If production breaks:

workspace
→ Commits
→ Revert previous Promote to Live commit

OR

Restore previous locked version.


RECOMMENDED WORKSPACE RELEASE PROCESS
=====================================

workspace-test
      ↓
Implement
      ↓
Validate
      ↓
Lock SHA-256
      ↓
Promote to Live
      ↓
Verify Production
      ↓
Update Stable Baseline
